entries.english:
Fiefs of the von Rosenberg and Roth von Schreckenstein families.

Date range: 1551–1679

Contents: requests for information about the fiefs of the von Rosenberg family (1630); transfer of the von Rosenberg family’s fiefs to the counts of Hatzfeld (1679); requests for information about the fiefs of the Roth von Schreckenstein family (1551/52).

Extent: 1 folder (1 cm)
